description: project-roles.md is the authoritative page for Capella's project-scope role catalog (Project Owner, Cluster Manager, Cluster Viewer, Data Reader, Data Writer) - referenced by name across many statement Prerequisites sections - but the page itself is a truncated ~28-line stub with no See Also section, and its 3 sibling pages (manage-projects.md, manage-project-users.md, projects.md) link to it while it doesn't link back. A page this structurally central deserves more than a stub.
